metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Add **ADR-043**: Rust MCP Runtime Sidecar with Mode-Based Rollout — standardizes the Rust sidecar deployment model with `RUST_MCP_MODE` (`off`/`shadow`/`edge`/`full`) and supersedes ADR-038.
- Add **ADR-044**: Internal Modular Architecture for Gateway Core — proposes decomposing the gateway's god files (`main.py`, `admin.py`, `db.py`, `streamablehttp_transport.py`) into a modular package structure with clear service boundaries.
- Update the ADR index to include both new ADRs and mark ADR-038 as Superseded.
- Update `.markdownlint-cli2.yaml` with linting config adjustments.


---
Refs #3730

commits.message:
docs: add ADR-043 (Rust MCP runtime sidecar) and ADR-044 (internal modular architecture)

ADR-043 supersedes ADR-038 to document the Rust MCP runtime sidecar with
a mode-based rollout model (off/shadow/edge/full). ADR-044 proposes
decomposing the gateway-core god files into 8 component modules with
standard lifecycle contracts and dependency injection.

Also updates markdownlint config (MD060 tight style) and marks ADR-038
as superseded in the ADR index.
